title: Canonical evaluation on fixed Hom representatives
statement: Let $J$ be a site on a category with object universe $c$ and morphism universe $v$, and let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings with rings and modules in universe $\max(c,v,u)$. Use its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], Hom complexes and their actual chosen product projections [def-pur-hom-complex], and fixed functorial K-injective replacement $I(M)$ [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] used to define derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. For complexes $P,L,M$, a chain map $\phi:P\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,I(M))$, integers $p,q,k$ with $q+p=k$, an object $U$, and local sections $x\in P^p(U)$ and $y\in L^q(U)$, define the representative evaluation to be $\pi_{p,q,k}(\phi^p(x))(y)\in I(M)^k(U)$. The evaluation of the local Hom section is at the identity object of the localized site over $U$. Keep with this definition the actual localization factorization $R\mathcal Hom(QL,QM)\cong Q\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,I(M))$ and the inverse of the localized augmentation $QM\to QI(M)$; no new replacement or arbitrary comparison is chosen.
